title: Nice print but unfinished trim and double the price of Home Goods & TJX bags
text:
Nice print but unfinished trim and double the price of Home Goods & TJX bags. I'm actually sorry I ordered these. These are the EXACT same size as the $.99 cent colorful plastic Home Goods and TJX bags that are sold in those stores and there is more variety there. The only difference between these bags and the store brand is that these are more than double the price, the trim is unkempt and extends at various lengths beyond the bags, and there is no logo on these bags (the only positive beside the print). 

These are tall, large, and moderately wide and will fit the same amount as the typical Home Goods bags. The paw print design is nice. However, I do not like the feel of the thin handles nor the trim extensions on the edges (see photo). The handles are a thin plastic and not cloth, so they cut into my hands. The cloth handles on the Home Goods/TJX bags are more comfortable to hold and last longer.

At the current price of $13.99, this comes to $2.33 per bag. At this price I could have purchased 14 bags at Home Goods instead of the 6 here. I expected these to be better quality and a little bit wider.
